facts.quote: Companies generate an average return of [$5.44 for every $1]

facts.fact: According to the article, B2B marketing automation investments see ROI in under six months, per the page's claim.
facts.quote: and see ROI in under six months.

facts.fact: According to the article, 91% of decision-makers report rising demand from teams to scale B2B automation efforts.
facts.quote: 91% of decision-makers report rising demand from teams to scale these efforts.

facts.fact: The article's phased roadmap defines Phase 1 (Quick Wins) as running Months 1–3 after launch.
The article's phased roadmap defines Phase 2 (Operational Foundation) as running Months 4–9 after launch.
The article was published on July 22, 2025.
StackAdapt's blog outlines a three-phase B2B marketing automation roadmap, with Phase 3 'Strategic Scale' running from month 10 to month 18 or later.
